name: Coinbase
label: Coinbase — Advanced Trade REST v3 (CDP); INTX cutover 2026-09-09
description: Official Coinbase Advanced Trade REST v3 (CDP). Docs: https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/api-reference/advanced-trade-api/rest-api/introduction. Coinbase Pro retired 2023-12-01 — do not use Pro keys or api.pro.coinbase.com. Spot and US futures stay on this v3 REST. International derivatives hard-cut over on 2026-09-09 from INTX REST (/api/v3/brokerage/intx/) to the Deribit-powered JSON-RPC gateway https://drb.coinbase.com/api/v2 — those INTX paths are not this node and stop serving at cutover. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress. Not investment advice. Geo restrictions; travel-rule on withdrawals. Bind a CDP JWT as api_key (engine does not sign CB-ACCESS headers).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Coinbase. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: account_list | transaction_list | order_create | order_get | price_get | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: product_id
schema.description: URL path/query-string/request-body parameter `product_id` for operations: transaction_list, order_create, price_get. Required by: price_get.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: account_list | transaction_list | order_create | order_get | price_get | trigger. Default account_list. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: CDP JWT minted outside StudioQuack (engine does not sign with an API secret). Bearer Authorization. Never INPUT, never logged.
